newsitem.title: INDIA: India's SBI cuts prime rate to 15.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: India's SBI cuts prime rate to 15.5 pct.

text.p: India's largest commercial bank State Bank of India (SBI) said on Thursday it was cutting its prime lending rate to 15.5 percent per annum from 16 percent, effective September 6.
"The said rate is exclusive of interest tax," the bank said in a statement issued after a board meeting on Thursday.
Analysts said the rate cut, applicable to the bank's top-rated customers, had been expected and was in response to improved liquidity in the banking system.
